sourceGaps: All35 actual original page PNGs personally opened and fully read in bounded windows by this same GPT-6.1 Sol ultra original reader: nine question pages,22 repeated-question/complete official-key pages and four recovered D02-only Summary Answersheet pages. Two native whole tasks D01/D02,12 printed numbered groups and31 leaf requests (20 D01 +11 D02); catalogue32 differs. Every nested letter/request and interleaved method/data/context remains inside its native whole task.

Every obtained official D01/D02 solution is fully transcribed, including error propagation, numerical substitutions, extrema/limb-darkening/radius-inclination data tables, full boxed formulas, all empirical/drag-model cases C1–C4, arrival-time/validity calculations and the final solar-wind table/average. Eight actual unique key graphics preserve original fits, extreme lines, uncertainties, annotations, axes/scales and intersection readings. Repeated question prompts/figures in key are already fully retained in original question content.

Recovered four-page Summary Answersheet prints Q.No.D02 exclusively, SA-1FRONT/SA-2BACK/SA-3FRONT/SA-4BACK. Exact standalone original source identity, all input tables, intentionally blank response fields/boxes, graph numbers/marks and final tail retained in four source-bound D02-labelled documentNotes. No extra tasks invented from blank forms. The source is mechanically sparse (six retained text-layer words); all four actual images and native tables/fields are personally read/hash-bound, without claiming a trusted text-layer comparison of them.

D01 repeatedly refers to separate Summary Answersheet grids/tables/response forms. None is present among the three obtainable catalogue companions; recovered forms cover D02 only. All radial/transit data graphs printed in the question and key booklets survive. Referenced D01-specific blank forms remain an explicit public caveat/source gap, with no invented grids, tabular values or quiz photographs.

Question source errors preserved: D01 radial-method prose calls vr,max and vr,min the minimum and maximum respectively in that order. D02 assumes the region between Sun and Earth is vacuum for parts1/2 although its introductory discussion lists other forces. No silent scientific correction of any source model/value.

Official D01 key page3 extrema table physically extends beyond the bottom of the original PDF page; only original visible rows1–11 retained, with printed blank K fields. No inferred row12/sixth pair invented. The subsequent original mean321.67 and calculations remain. Official key page9 limb-darkening table prints two extra20/40-degree data rows, J=.970/.890, beyond the question table; all14 printed rows, including both inconsistent additions, are retained.

Official D02 key page17 uses v1,m again for CME-2 and literally says percentage error is arrival time; both retained. Page19 C2 final line prints t=58.05 without unit; retained. Page22 text says model start and uses0.20h/4h although preceding midpoint cases give0.340h/4.5h; original text retained. The key graph handwritten acceleration uncertainty differs from rounded boxed value; both original annotation and boxed value remain.

Twelve retained unique actual original300dpi crop resources (four question/eight official-key) cover16 printed figure occurrences, including four repeated question graphics in key. All12 retained exact byte hashes personally opened with original detail, accepted and canonical-tool public200 verified. Ten final generated copies byte-identical to personally opened originals; two narrowly recropped plots exclude only tiny adjacent source prose, with all graph scope intact. Old crop bytes/revision proof retained. No masks/redrawing/formula screenshots or invented plots.

Initial isolated Q/S PDFs and new complete transaction PDFs are exact SHA256-identical. Companion preparation rerendered current Q/S previews under a newer renderer fingerprint, changing PNG bytes/pixels. Actual read Q pages are the old source-owned image aliases; official key/supplement pages are the new complete transaction images. Evidence names actual read image files/hashes, both manifests and exact source aliases. No false claim that new Q PNG bytes were read or equal to old images.

Raw v6 wording alert arose from supplement blank-form text initially placed in statementAfterParts and thus mechanically mapped to Q page6. Exact unchanged form text now has supported supplement-1 documentNotes/page1–4 identity; no source wording edit/exemption or parser bypass. Numeric ordinal numbers1/2 satisfy validator; native printed D01/D02 remain in titles, stable IDs, every group/letter/form heading. Full official key uses supported singular paper.solutionSource and all22 source pages.
